description: The minimum the popup window needs: show and hide itself, and drag a frameless window by its header. Deliberately no clipboard permission — every clipboard write goes through the `copy_item` command, so a sensitive item's plaintext never has to enter the WebView in order to be copied. Granting `clipboard-manager:allow-write-text` would let any script in the WebView write the system clipboard directly, which is a capability the app does not need.
